Name: Forest Meadow Farm
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[b]features[/b]

* all the grass is tillable
* lots of berry bushes around the map
* 9x renewable hardwood stumps
* troughs and fountain are water sources
* replaces [b]forest [/b]farm (configurable)


[b]requirements[/b]

* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]smapi[/url]
* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]
* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]daisyniko's tilesheets[/url]


[b]installation[/b]

1. install all of the required mods
2. download this mod and open the .zip folder
3. extract the "[CP] Forest Meadow Farm" folder to your Mods folder
4. run the game with smapi and start a new save on the [b]forest [/b]farm


[b]config options

[/b]MapToReplace: Standard, Forest, Riverland, Hilltop, or Wilderness
